intended_use: Hackathon demonstration and offline research only
not_for: Production routing, emergency response, or public safety decisions
caveat: 38 confirmed disruption events plus 24 observation-backed negative road-status records (328 samples: 114 positives, 214 negatives) across 10 NH corridors; negatives include assumed-unaffected roads. Grouped leave-one-corridor-out CV: accuracy=0.607, avg_precision=0.388, brier_score=0.250, f1=0.218, false_negative_rate=0.842, false_negatives=96.000, false_positives=33.000, precision=0.353, recall=0.158, roc_auc=0.555. This is a real-data model but NOT a production/deployable hazard classifier; metrics are exploratory and high-variance. Not production-safe.
